# N cultural_and_special_occasion_garments

Garments with silhouettes outside everyday western tops/bottoms.

## N01 qipao dress seed

- Expected: dress x1
- Difficulty: cultural, dress, side_slit
- Acceptance: Qipao should map to dress.

```text
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: studio product photo of a red qipao cheongsam dress laid flat on a light gray background, high collar and side slit visible, no model, no text. Composition/framing: keep the relevant garment or object fully visible unless the case explicitly asks for crop. Lighting/mood: realistic natural or studio lighting. Constraints: avoid brand logos, readable text, watermarks, and unrelated extra garments unless requested.
```
